query_strategy: Use the official dataset-keyed eurobis-obisenv_full WFS route exposed by MarineInfo, passing each IMIS dataset ID through viewParams. For each of the 40 frozen queue IDs, archive a frozen-domain-bounding-box resultType=hits response. Exhaust every bounding-box hit in deterministic ID pages, then intersect its returned geometry locally with the checksum-pinned unsimplified Greater North Sea polygon. Do not run an unbounded occurrence-layer count: the generic eurobis preflight scan was non-responsive and is not needed to decide frozen-domain intersection.
decision_boundary: A title signal never sets a final decision. Zero bounding-box records diagnoses absence of occurrence evidence capable of intersecting the frozen domain, without claiming that the dataset is globally empty. Bounding-box records require local exact-polygon intersection and provider-identity review.
license: EMODnet metadata; occurrence terms and licences remain per underlying EurOBIS dataset
